name: Edgecurve Buckle
description: Qi drawn slowly along the haft warms the grip and settles the axe's weight in the palm.

name: Rushing Hurl
description: A downstroke rides a pulse of qi from shoulder to bit and lands heavier than muscle alone allows.

name: Lightbit Scorer
description: A short throw released on a qi pulse sets the axe spinning evenly for a clean landing at six paces.

name: Layered Spikepoll
description: Leaning from the hips, the user turns a cut off the haft instead of meeting it squarely.

name: Raw Birchhelve
description: Qi passes along the haft into the release so the axe flies farther and bites harder than a plain throw.

name: Birchswat
description: A concentrated pulse down the haft drives the bit through a shield rim or light mail in one chop.

name: Acrid Throwhelve
description: Both axes leave the belt together, one drawn high and one low, ready to cut.

name: Dense Quickbit
description: The two axes cross before the chest and lock an incoming blade between the hafts.

name: Brutal Balancepoint
description: Left and right axes chop in turn, each stroke recovering as the other lands.

name: Pirouetting Pitch
description: The user steps through a gap with both axes held low and clear of the legs.

name: Cramping Lob
description: The off-hand axe hooks a weapon arm while the main axe holds its guard.

name: Flingswat
description: One axe braces a parry while the other is thrown overhand at the exposed flank.

name: Stern Toss
description: Both axes are thrown on crossing lines so one catches the dodger the other missed.

name: Tossthwack
description: Both bits are driven together into a shield's centre and split its boards along the grain.

name: Genial Tomahead
description: The user sets the stance after measuring the distance to the target by eye and pace.

name: Chuckswat
description: Released from a distance where it turns two thirds of a revolution, the axe lands with the bit angled down.

name: Brisk Thumbnotch
description: Gripping the haft's very end gives a long cut that reaches past the opponent's guard.

name: Prowling Fling
description: A step taken as the axe leaves the hand keeps the user moving and out of the counter.

name: Flintprop
description: The axe head's flat skids a spear point off its line and past the hip.

name: Hurlslap
description: A hard throw sends the axe many turns beyond ordinary range, its spin keeping the bit forward.

name: Ruthless Tailknob
description: Rapid throws at one spot keep a defender behind cover and unable to rise.

name: Chuckscorer
description: A three-count of step, turn and release makes the throw one smooth motion.

name: Candor Throwhelve
description: A glance at the bit's angle before release lets the user correct a short or long toss.

name: Keen Balancepoint
description: The wrist is cocked on the draw and snapped forward so the chop lands before the opponent reacts.

name: Headbuckle
description: Weight settles low behind the haft while the user backs away from a charge.

name: Draught Pitch
description: The haft's end drives upward into the chin and snaps the opponent's head back.

name: Headstalk
description: Right after release the user steps in behind the thrown axe, ready to draw another.

name: Hurlthwack
description: Two axes leave a heartbeat apart at one target, the first at the face and the second at the legs.

name: Rill Lightbit
description: The bit hooks an incoming blade and wedges it against the haft, stopping the blow dead.

name: Draught Thumbnotch
description: Stepping under a high swing, the user brings the bit up in a rising cut to the ribs.

name: Sprig Tailknob
description: Held beard-forward, the axe lets any sword that slides down the head find the hook.

name: Discord Fling
description: The beard hooks a wrist and pulls it across the opponent's body, spoiling the next cut.

name: Entangling Lob
description: The beard bites a shield's rim and drags it low, uncovering the head.

name: Weighty Quickbit
description: The beard rests behind the neck guard and a turn of the user's body spins the opponent round.

name: Static Tomahead
description: The beard catches behind a heel and pulls, tripping a retreating opponent.

name: Static Toss
description: Once the beard holds, the axe rotates and the bit chops into the trapped limb.

name: Spikepoll Barrier
description: Both hands on the haft, the beard catches a thrusting blade and turns it outward.

name: Sprig Hurl
description: The beard locks behind a sword's cross-guard and a rolling twist wrenches the blade from the hand.

name: Edgecurve Flog
description: The thrown axe's beard snags a cloak or banner and pins it, hampering the fleeing target.

name: Humlob
description: With the beard under a shield's lower rim the user levers on the haft and flips it up and away.

name: Ember Birchhelve
description: The axe is drawn and thrown in one wrist turn, leaving no pause between belt and flight.

name: Poiseflint
description: An open palm on the axe's flat turns a blow aside like a small shield.

name: Draught Chuck
description: From inside the opponent's reach a wrist turn brings the bit down onto the collarbone.

name: Clay Chuck
description: A slide on the heel turns the user ninety degrees as the opponent lunges past.

name: Tossscorer
description: A whipped release adds a turn to the axe, driving the bit through leather and padding at long range.

name: Mirage Thumbnotch
description: A reversed wrist turn takes a thrown blade on the haft and flicks it back toward the thrower.

name: Flintcordial
description: A held breath tunes qi through the bit so its edge holds against hard leather and wood.

name: Ember Quickbit
description: A qi-tempered chop splits a shield board or lance haft without chipping the bit.

name: Static Lightbit
description: The poll lands a ringing blow on plate, the qi carrying the shock through the armor.

name: Sleet Tailknob
description: Qi in hands and wrists turns a heavy blow aside on the haft, wedging it against the beard.

name: Rillfling
description: Short steps carry the user between throws while a second axe slides from the belt.

name: Comet Balancepoint
description: A coiled arm uncoils through the release and throws the axe flat and fast at a charging opponent.

name: Savage Hurl
description: Qi stored in the bit just before release drives the thrown axe through a mail coat.

name: Poise Tomahead
description: The tempered haft stops a descending blow and snaps back with a counter cut.

name: Sprig Birchhelve
description: The user advances at a walk with the axe held across the body, giving no opening.

name: Clayfling
description: A chop timed to the third running stride carries the body's full speed into the bit.

name: Shard Throwhelve
description: The axe is thrown without breaking stride, trading some accuracy for the surprise of speed.

name: Rillbirch
description: A sharp step around a corner or pillar breaks sight before the user reappears with a chop.

name: Balancepoint Screen
description: A running parry turns a blade aside with the haft while the user's pace carries them past.

name: Sleetchuck
description: At full run two axes leave the hands on successive strides, one high and one low, at the same quarry.

name: Grit Chuck
description: A zigzag charge closes the distance across open ground while spoiling an archer's aim.
